description: This file defines a mock class 'DRMScreenCaptureApiImplMock' for testing purposes. It mocks the methods of the 'DRMScreenCaptureApiImpl' interface using Google Mock framework, including initialization, screen info retrieval, screen capture, and destruction methods.

classes.name: DRMScreenCaptureApiImplMock
classes.description: Mock class for 'DRMScreenCaptureApiImpl' providing Google Mock implementations for its methods.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Mocks the initialization method returning a pointer to DRMScreenCapture.

methods.name: GetScreenInfo
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of screen information, returns a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: ScreenCapture
methods.description: Mocks the screen capture process, filling output buffer, returns success status.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Mocks the destruction of screen capture handle.
